page.overview:
Who is Damia?

Once completes the , congratulates him. He then offers another trial, the , which has a shorter time limit. If can make it to within five minutes, promises him a prize. However, he requires a security deposit of 20 , which covers the cost of gear rental.

If agrees, explains that the rules are the same as before. He then goes to set everything up. When reaches the , shouts that he reached the goal. The prize for making it in under five minutes is a , which hopes likes.

When breaks his record, asserts that he knew would be good at the . He asks to let him know if he wants to come back and break his record. If is done playing, will take his back and return him to the start.
